content.overview: Article 32 guarantees the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of Part III rights and authorises writs. Article 226 empowers High Courts for Fundamental Rights and for any other purpose.
content.study: Article 32 is itself a Fundamental Right confined to Part III. Article 226 is wider but not a Fundamental Right. PIL liberalises standing; it does not enlarge Article 32 beyond Fundamental Rights. Cross-read PIL topics.

sections.heading: Art 32 vs Art 226
sections.body: Prefer 226 for territorial convenience or non-FR public-law wrongs; use 32 for Part III in the Supreme Court.
